reason: A source-only audit found that the current point-oriented C3V diagnostic, result decimal carrier, and generic_numeric fallback cannot implement ADR-0004's validated-box boundary. This amendment fixes the development allocation, exact-input projection, explicit-callback predicate, safety subtrials, denominator, and one-shot ordering before dependencies, fixtures, inputs, or V1 mechanism code exist.

timing.restriction: This amendment may determine source allocation and safety controls only. It cannot tune a threshold or support promotion or rejection.

source_audit.finding: The product OperatorKernel currently permits C3V with validated=nothing when generic_numeric=true, and the reference interpreter then invokes evaluator for C3V.
source_audit.resolution: Do not change the product ABI, Core API, graph wire format, or point semantics in this experiment scaffold. Research V1 requires supports(C3V) and a non-nothing explicit validated callback. A generic-only declaration is a mandatory typed-unsupported negative control.

source_audit.finding: evaluate_reference enforces point runtime types, finite Real values, scalar comparisons, point Selection margins, and point branch decisions. Passing interval boxes through it would silently reuse point semantics.
source_audit.resolution: V1 uses a separate optional validated-box interpreter after inputs freeze. It consumes the same canonical graph structure but never calls the point interpreter and never falls back to a point observation.

source_audit.finding: ProtocolDecimal is an internal result-wire carrier, explicitly not a general arithmetic type. Its text is canonical and lossless; its BigFloat value is a finite point approximation and is not a proof endpoint.
source_audit.resolution: The research exact-input codec takes the canonical ProtocolDecimal.text spelling as the decimal token and passes that text directly to the future outward interval constructor. It never constructs a proof endpoint from ProtocolDecimal.value. Reduced rational text is likewise converted exactly before outward rounding.

source_audit.finding: The v1 problem graph intentionally preserves binary float bits and point values; its variable bounds and floating literals are not an exact proof-box transport.
source_audit.resolution: Keep the v1 problem and plugin protocols unchanged. Exact proof boxes are a research sidecar bound to the problem hash. A future validated literal interpretation must use exact textual or reduced-rational fixture material, never re-label a binary graph value as an exact decimal.

product_freeze.research_predicate: An executed operation is V1-capable only when C3V is declared, validated is explicitly non-nothing, the plugin content lock matches, and every executed validated value remains guaranteed and at the frozen safe decoration. generic_numeric never satisfies this predicate by itself.
product_freeze.failure_behavior: Any missing explicit callback is typed capability-unavailable before the operation is invoked. No evaluator, high_precision, C2 derivative, finite difference, BigFloat point replay, or point inflation path is tried.

base_case_accounting.efficacy_denominator: Only the 24 VERIFY-REGULAR-COMPOSED base cases enter p_unique_configuration_certified. All other base cases and all subtrials are predeclared safety or applicability controls and cannot dilute or increase that denominator.

blocks.allocation: dimension index d in [1,2,4,8] outer, condition index c in [1,1e4,1e8] middle, replicate r in [0,1] inner; radius index=(d_index+c_index+r) mod 3; representation index=(d_index+2*c_index+r) mod 3
blocks.coverage: Each dimension has 6 cases; each condition, radius, and representation has 8. All 24 are independently regular and efficacy-eligible.

blocks.allocation: surface in [division-domain,square-root-domain,strict-guard,two-choice-selector] outer and box_state in [strictly-inside,touching,crossing] inner; margin_scale index=(surface_index+box_state_index) mod 3
blocks.coverage: Every surface-state pair occurs exactly once and each margin scale occurs four times.

blocks.allocation: root_kind in [double,cubic,constant-target-manifold,varying-target-manifold] outer and nullity in [1,2] inner; dimension alternates by (root_kind_index+nullity_index) mod 2 over [2,4]
blocks.coverage: Every root-kind/nullity pair occurs exactly once and each dimension occurs four times.

blocks.allocation: input index in [decimal-0.1,large-rational,subnormal-neighborhood,binary-pre-rounded] is paired with the same primary interval-state index in [guaranteed-common,non-guaranteed,trivial,ill-formed]
blocks.coverage: Every input and interval state occurs once in the 48-case base split; 12 frozen safety subtrials complete the remaining input-state Cartesian pairs.

classes.rule: For each VDEV-045..VDEV-048 input, execute each of the three interval states not used by its primary base case. Together with the four base trials this is the full 4 by 4 input-state matrix.
classes.gate: Only exact decimal or reduced-rational provenance with guaranteed common decoration can be eligible; binary-pre-rounded provenance remains ineligible under every interval state.

classes.rule: For each predeclared source VDEV-001, VDEV-007, VDEV-013, and VDEV-024, replay one none control and one each of box, plugin-lock, jacobian, krawczyk-image, and configuration-hash mutations.
classes.gate: The four none controls must replay; every one of the twenty mutated artifacts must be rejected. These are replay trials, not new certifications.

classes.rule: For each opaque regular source VDEV-002, VDEV-007, VDEV-015, and VDEV-023, substitute once a plugin with no C3V and once a plugin declaring C3V with generic_numeric=true but validated=nothing.
classes.gate: All eight return typed capability-unavailable before any validated operation, interval work, or artifact construction.

exact_input_contract.accepted_decimal: A canonical finite decimal spelling that round-trips byte-for-byte as ProtocolDecimal.text. The future backend constructs the outward endpoint directly from text.
exact_input_contract.accepted_rational: Canonical reduced signed numerator text and positive denominator text; conversion to an interval is exact before outward rounding.
forbidden_sources: a Float16, Float32, Float64, or BigFloat point subsequently described as the intended exact decimal
a JSON number without explicit binary provenance when exact decimal intent is claimed
exact_input_contract.binary_negative: binary-pre-rounded is tagged with binary64 provenance and the intended decimal spelling. It is a mandatory negative even if its printed decimal looks canonical or an interval backend could enclose the binary value.
exact_input_contract.box_binding: The proof-box sidecar binds the problem hash, ordered variable IDs, exact lower and upper tokens, provenance, endpoint inclusion convention, and candidate point endpoint. It does not modify product variable bounds.

candidate_allowed: opaque trial and mutation instruction IDs
candidate_forbidden: analytic root, rank, multiplicity, feasible-set dimension, or target Gold
candidate_assessor_separation.checksum_rule: Candidate case and manifest checksums are computed only from canonical candidate-visible documents. No assessor, family, Gold, eligibility, expectation, or mutation map byte contributes.
candidate_assessor_separation.routing_zero_gate: Static and dynamic audits must find zero candidate branches or lookups on case ID, fixture descriptor ID, primitive name, family, factor, Gold, VREF result, or mutation instruction ID. Opaque instruction IDs are interpreted only by the external safety executor.

fixture_and_materialization_order.fixture_descriptor_phase: This amendment contains descriptors and allocation only. It contains no callbacks or content locks.
fixture_and_materialization_order.dependency_phase: Pin IntervalArithmetic and IntervalRootFinding only after this source lock. No package object enters Base, Core, the v1 graph, or candidate inputs.
fixture_and_materialization_order.fixture_phase: After dependency pinning, implement content-locked research fixtures with explicit validated callbacks, including an opaque custom intermediate type. Freeze their source and plugin locks before materialization.
fixture_and_materialization_order.one_shot_phase: A later materializer verifies the card, ADR, amendment, generator, assessor, dependency, and fixture hashes; rejects any existing candidate or assessor output; and rejects any validated interpreter, Krawczyk candidate, artifact encoder, or replay verifier source.
fixture_and_materialization_order.mechanism_phase: V1 work starts only after separate candidate and assessor trees are atomically materialized and checksummed.

safety_invariants_addendum: The point reference interpreter never receives interval values and is not called by V1.
The existing generic_numeric product fallback is never evidence of an explicit V1 callback.
ProtocolDecimal.text, not ProtocolDecimal.value, carries exact decimal intent to outward construction.
Fixture descriptors preserve Literal, Reference, content-locked plugin Call, custom opaque intermediate, guard, domain, branch, Select, and target expressiveness without polynomial lowering.
No generated manifest, Gold artifact, dependency, callback, mechanism, or outcome exists at this amendment checkpoint.
